programs.title: Union with David Olusoga
programs.desc: David Olusoga, professor of public history at the University of Manchester, tells the story of one of the most influential and delicate unions in the world.The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, established in 1800, is currently facing a serious crisis.The causes of division are deeply hidden in history.Olusoga explains what they are and presents the fate of people connected with the historical turmoil.It will also present important elements in the formation of British identity.

programs.title: Icons of Auto
programs.desc: Stories of famous automotive brands.Their logos are recognizable on every continent, and subsequent car models are desired by collectors.We will get to know five iconic models of each brand.

programs.title: Disasters Engineered
programs.desc: A series devoted to the greatest engineering disasters in the history of mankind.Chernobyl, Titanic and Hinderburg - these are examples of bold technological experiments that ended tragically.

programs.title: Israel and the Palestinians: The Road to 7th October
programs.desc: Recognized documentarian, Emmy and BAFTA winner, Norma Percy, deals with the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and asks how it is possible that the conflict escalated during the intense search for peace in the Middle East.The filmmakers begin with Israel's withdrawal from the Gaza Strip in September 2005.The program reveals the behind-the-scenes of decades-long diplomatic disputes until October 7, 2023.Percy's interviewees, including:Hillary Clinton, Tony Blair and leading Israeli and Palestinian politicians discuss the causes of the dispute and breakthrough events in relations between the parties.
